title: Why this ancient cable still connects to modern TVs with a simple adapter
description: DVI to HDMI adapters are a cheap and simple way to connect up old hardware, but don't expect miracles.

title: Anthony Albanese urged to phase out fossil fuels as faith leaders launch nationwide campaign ahead of COP31
description: A Pacific event will set the agenda for the United Nations' global climate summit and groups are calling for Australia to push ambitious goals.

title: Fossil fuel phase-out, climate funds top pre-COP agenda
description: Banners will fly outside churches, cathedrals and temples across five states to urge Australia to step up support for Pacific nations and phase out fossil fuels.
